observation: decode->re-encode is not perfectly idempotent; truncated generations re-tokenise to 509-513 tokens
direction_of_bias: any truncated row counted as not-truncated can only raise zero-shot confident_error, i.e. shrink the FT-minus-ZS difference tested in A7 (conservative for the pre-registered direction)
mistral_tokenizer_warning: transformers warns the Mistral-Nemo tokenizer regex differs from the reference; the same default tokenizer was used at generation time in Stage 6, so counts are consistent with the cap. fix_mistral_regex=True is not supported by this transformers build.
decision: threshold kept as pre-registered; caveat carried into significance.md
